diagnosis.what_happened: Conversational meta-annotation prose ('جامعیت: این فهرست شامل تمامی ارجاعات موجود در متن فصول ۲.۱ تا ۲.۷...') leaked into the master thesis bibliography section.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Reference extraction and assembly logic failed to exclude conversational meta-notes and prefaces, allowing non-reference summary prose to pass into production deliverables.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The bibliography must strictly contain pure bibliographic entries; all conversational prefaces and meta-annotations must be stripped.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Academic theses and reference deliverables strictly forbid conversational prefaces or editor commentary in bibliography sections.

desired_behavior: Strictly exclude conversational prefaces, meta-annotations, and summary commentary (e.g., 'جامعیت:', 'توجه:', 'یادداشت:', 'Note:') from all reference sections and master thesis deliverables.
generalization: Bibliographic artifacts must strictly contain verified citation entries and never conversational meta-prose or summary annotations.

evidence.threshold_value: Zero non-bibliographic text allowed in references
